key_phrases: RTX SUPER... sold out almost everywhere
pricing in the spot market is drifting higher than MSRP
AI is the single most powerful technology force of our time
analysis.reasoning: The management exhibits extremely high confidence, particularly CEO Jensen Huang, focusing on the long-term transformative potential of AI and the successful launch of the RTX SUPER lineup. While year-on-year revenue declined due to cyclicality in gaming and specific hyperscaler weakness, sequential growth is strong across most segments. The company demonstrates significant pricing power (spot prices above MSRP) and a massive competitive moat through its CUDA ecosystem and software stack. QA was direct, with management providing detailed technical and financial justifications for margin expansion and data center trends.
